description: EXP bit-exactness probe (T-1778 round 4, exp-exact). A = a, B = EXP(a). Every a is chosen so that the exact 2^t, t = RN64(a*RN64(log2 e)), lies within 1.5/2048 ulp of a binary64 rounding midpoint, so B reveals the sign of the error of Excel's 64-bit 2^frac(t) (F2XM1) at that point. Layout: 300 clusters (f0 = target frac(t); 120 in [0,0.585), 180 in [0.585,1)) x 5 exponents n = floor(t) in order (-1,-25,-1000,2,1000) x 20 consecutive-double hits; row = 1 + 100*cluster + 20*k + j. Within a cluster frac(t) varies by < 6E-9. Generator: inv4/exp-exact/search2.c cluster, gen_probe.py.
